summary:
Experienced and results-oriented Flutter Developer with 3+ years of hands-on experience in developing scalable, high-
performance cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart. Skilled in state management (Bloc, GetX),
RESTful API integration, and clean architecture. Delivered impactful solutions in e-commerce, travel, health tech, and
government sectors. Strong focus on code quality, performance optimization, unit testing, and team mentorship.
